analysis_type: Post-hoc comparison of three internal and five external same-point bound decompositions; no refitting or new experiment

comparison_rule.available_points: 369 internal plus 392 external equals 761 descriptive available points, not a universal sample or probability estimate
comparison_rule.scope_separation: Retain two internal rooted unavailable folds separately from 201 external unavailable points; do not create a combined success rate
comparison_rule.classification: Reuse the already frozen 0.5 dominance classifications without retuning
comparison_rule.validation: Require zero source identity mismatches and zero undefined zero bounds in both inputs
comparison_rule.datasets: Preserve Hahn1, Thurber, Kirby2, Filip, MGH17, Gauss1, Misra1a and Chwirut1 as separate distributions
comparison_rule.related_dataset_scope: Chwirut1 was not used in previous region design, but shares its study and native model family with Chwirut2; it is not an independent model-family or laboratory replication test

prohibitions: No universal internal-versus-external ranking or combined success rate
No erasure of internal rooted folds, external unavailable points or Chwirut1/Chwirut2 relatedness
No probability, variance-decomposition or physical-mechanism interpretation of arithmetic shares
